findings.issue: PROP-005's stated pass criterion is self-contradictory against the actual code. Its method is `grep -inE "claude|sonnet|clawrouter|anthropic|blockrun" producer.sh run.sh monitor.sh _instance_paths.sh` and it declares 'the ONLY permitted hits are comments/docs, never executable conditionals.' Running that exact grep on the real files returns FOUR executable variable-assignment lines: producer.sh:15 `SKILLS="$HOME/.claude/skills/earn-clip-rewards/scripts"`, run.sh:25 `POSTER="$HOME_DIR/.claude/skills/ig-reels-poster/..."`, run.sh:26 `CDP_DIR="$HOME_DIR/.claude/skills/ig-account-create/scripts"`, monitor.sh:10 same. These are legitimate `.claude/skills/` filesystem paths — NOT comments/docs and NOT model-specific branching conditionals — so they fall in an undefined gap in PROP-005's criterion. A mechanical Phase 3 reviewer following the criterion literally will either mark PASS-worthy code as FAIL (permitted-set = comments/docs only) or be forced into an unspecified judgment call the architecture claims to have removed. This defect lands squarely on the ONE obligation the Gate (line 39) singles out for mandatory re-verification as 'most likely to silently regress,' so its reliability matters most. Fix: either narrow the grep to word-boundary model tokens that exclude the `.claude`/`ig-account-create` path segments, or explicitly enumerate `.claude/skills` path references as permitted non-branching hits.

REQ-004 states an unconditional guarantee that resolved queue/posted/accounts/LEDGER paths 'never intersect' across N instances, but REQ-003 lets an explicitly-set EARN_LEDGER override the ledger to any path regardless of ANICCA_INSTANCE. If two instances run with the same EARN_LEDGER exported in the shared process environment, their ledgers collide — violating REQ-004's literal wording. REQ-003 does carve this out globally ('the ONLY sanctioned exception to REQ-002 ledger-suffixing'), and PROP-004's automated check exercises instance names WITHOUT EARN_LEDGER, so this is defensible, but REQ-004 does not restate that its guarantee is conditional on EARN_LEDGER being unset. Non-blocking; a one-clause note on REQ-004 would remove the residual ambiguity.
